required_action: Open a case from KPI miss, evaluation failure, unsafe action or repeated workflow defect.
acceptance_criteria: Affected role, evidence, severity and immediate risk are explicit.
closure_criteria: Output accepted by the next accountable step or the workflow reaches its required end state.

required_inputs: Workflow record; prior accepted outputs; applicable policy.
required_action: Validate that the failure is real and distinguish role, knowledge, tool, workflow, model and measurement causes.
acceptance_criteria: Failure is not inferred solely from one noisy outcome.
closure_criteria: Output accepted by the next accountable step or the workflow reaches its required end state.

required_inputs: Workflow record; prior accepted outputs; applicable policy.
required_action: Restrict consequential authority or runtime activation when risk requires it.
acceptance_criteria: Restriction is proportionate, traceable and has review conditions.
closure_criteria: Output accepted by the next accountable step or the workflow reaches its required end state.

required_inputs: Workflow record; prior accepted outputs; applicable policy.
required_action: Create targeted remediation for the validated competency or system gap.
acceptance_criteria: Plan targets the cause and uses a different verification case.
closure_criteria: Output accepted by the next accountable step or the workflow reaches its required end state.

required_action: Complete the approved training, workflow, role or process correction.

closure_criteria: Output accepted by the next accountable step or the workflow reaches its required end state.

required_inputs: Workflow record; prior accepted outputs; applicable policy.
required_action: Verify the remediated capability on new evidence or cases.
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer is independent and critical failures remain blocking.
closure_criteria: Output accepted by the next accountable step or the workflow reaches its required end state.

entry_condition: Prior required step accepted or workflow start event.
required_inputs: Workflow record; prior accepted outputs; applicable policy.
required_action: Restore authority, continue restriction, reassign work or propose retirement based on evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Decision follows verified capability and risk.
closure_criteria: Output accepted by the next accountable step or the workflow reaches its required end state.

entry_condition: Evidence indicates role/department/reporting design caused or amplified the failure.
required_inputs: Workflow record; prior accepted outputs; applicable policy.
required_action: Assess ownership, capacity, role overlap and reporting structure.
required_output: Organization change recommendation or no-change conclusion.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation is evidence-based and does not modify Phase A without formal approval.
closure_criteria: Output accepted by the next accountable step or the workflow reaches its required end state.

entry_condition: Approved capability gap cannot be filled by existing roles.
required_inputs: Workflow record; prior accepted outputs; applicable policy.
required_action: Define and source a new human or agent capability.
acceptance_criteria: No new role is created merely to preserve a count.
closure_criteria: Output accepted by the next accountable step or the workflow reaches its required end state.
founder_gate: Formal Phase A organizational change requires founder approval.

entry_condition: A structural organization change is recommended.
required_inputs: Workflow record; prior accepted outputs; applicable policy.
required_action: Prepare the formal Phase A change request for founder decision.
acceptance_criteria: Change includes evidence, workflow impact, role count, reporting and compatibility.
closure_criteria: Output accepted by the next accountable step or the workflow reaches its required end state.
founder_gate: Founder approval required to reopen Phase A.
